messages:
sophie_pm: Hey folks — quick policy question. I have a multi-day religious observance Dec 24-26 that I requested months ago, but our year-end blackout was Dec 23-27 and the calendar shows those days blocked. I also used my floating holiday on Dec 24 earlier in the year. Payroll now shows 2 PTO days deducted for 25-26. Is there any accommodation for religious observance that overlaps a company blackout or for when a floating day was used elsewhere?

Danielle_peopleops: Hi @sophie_pm thanks for flagging. Short answer: we have an accommodation process for religious observance. Blackouts only prevent proactive scheduling of PTO, they don’t deny protected leave. Since you have prior notice, we can treat this as an approved accommodation and reverse PTO provided we have either manager confirmation or documentation of the request. Because you used your floating holiday earlier, we need to decide whether to restore the 2 PTO days or apply an alternative (e.g., unpaid leave or an extra floating day).

Danielle_peopleops: Practical steps: 1) Submit the "Religious Accommodation / Leave Adjustment" form in the People Portal (link in the bot message). 2) Manager sign-off required (cc @kevin_manager). 3) People Ops reviews and posts a retro adjustment to your leave ledger. If payroll already processed we will do a ledger restore; payroll will coordinate any cash reversals only when necessary. Deadline for year-end retro adjustments is Jan 31 for the prior calendar year.

sophie_pm: Thanks — I did email Kevin and HR back in Oct with the dates. Is the email sufficient or do you need a formal doc? Also curious: if restored, do those days count toward the 5-day carryover cap next year? I’m trying to plan travel in Jan.

kevin_manager: I saw Sophies email and can confirm approval. @danielle_peopleops I can add a manager note in the portal. Email should be fine for religious observances; no medical note required.

Danielle_peopleops: Manager confirmation is sufficient. Regarding carryover: restored days increase your active balance and therefore fall under normal year-end carryover rules. However, for approved religious accommodations we can annotate the ledger for audit and we have discretion to allow an exception to the 5-day cap in rare cases with director sign-off. If you expect restored time to push you over the cap, let us know now so we can request pre-approval.

Mira_legal: quick legal note from my side: treat religious observance as a protected accommodation under our policy. We should avoid creating undue burdens (i.e., denying the leave because of a blackout). Document manager approval in the portal to create a clear audit trail; if we need to make a special carryover exception get @mira_legal looped for sign-off.

people-bot: People Portal form "Religious Accommodation / Leave Adjustment": https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/religious-accommodation (auto message). Reminder: attach manager approval email or portal approval screenshot to speed processing.

sophie_pm: Great — I submitted the portal form and attached my Oct email thread + Kevins approval. One more Q: is there any chance to exchange the restored PTO for an extra floating holiday instead? I prefer a single-day floating so I can use it later in the quarter.

Danielle_peopleops: We can sometimes offer a swap (convert restored PTO to a floating day) but its treated as an exception and requires approval from People Ops + Payroll (to avoid tax/reporting issues). If you want that route, note "swap to floating" in the form and well run it by Payroll. If payroll has already processed you may see the leave restored first and then a separate ledger entry converting the hours into one floating-day token.

kevin_manager: Im fine with the swap — approved. @sophie_pm Ill add a note that this is a religious accommodation and we prefer the floating-day swap.

Danielle_peopleops: Received your submission and manager approval. Ill coordinate with Payroll and Legal. Expect a confirmation here within 7 business days; if we approve the swap well show a ledger conversion and update your floating holiday balance. If you need the time back immediately for travel planning DM me and we can prioritize the request.

sophie_pm: Thanks all — much appreciated. Will DM if travel becomes urgent :pray:

Danielle_peopleops: Update: processed the request. Payroll notified and your ledger shows 16 hours restored and a pending conversion to one floating holiday. Youll see the floating day appear in the portal within 2 business days. We made a note that this was a religious accommodation and documented manager approval. If anything looks off ping me.

sophie_pm: I see the floating day now in the portal, perfect. Thanks everyone :heart:
